papers.title: Model-based Dashboards for Customer Analytics
papers.abstract: Automating the customer analytics process is crucial for companies that manage distinct customer bases. In such data-rich and dynamic environments, visualization plays a key role in understanding events of interest. These ideas have led to the popularity of analytics dashboards, yet academic research has paid scant attention to these managerial needs. We develop a probabilistic, nonparametric framework for understanding and predicting individual-level spending using Gaussian process priors over latent functions that describe customer spending along calendar time, interpurchase time, and customer lifetime dimensions. These curves form a dashboard that provides a visual model-based representation of purchasing dynamics that is easily comprehensible. The model flexibly and automatically captures the form and duration of the impact of events that influence spend propensity, even when such events are unknown a-priori. We illustrate the use of our Gaussian Process Propensity Model (GPPM) on data from two popular mobile games. We show that the GPPM generalizes hazard and buy-till-you-die models by incorporating calendar time dynamics while simultaneously accounting for recency and lifetime effects. It therefore provides insights about spending propensity beyond those available from these models. Finally, we show that the GPPM outperforms these benchmarks both in fitting and forecasting real and simulated spend data.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文是关于客户消费行为的概率建模，与有限元替代模型或生物力学设计无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on customer spending analytics using Gaussian processes, with no connection to surrogate modeling for FEA, implant design, biomechanics, or any engineering optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 企业需要自动化客户分析工具，但现有研究不足。
summary_zh.method: 提出高斯过程倾向模型，用潜函数描述消费行为。
summary_zh.result: 模型在拟合和预测消费数据上优于传统方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在手机游戏数据集上验证并对比基准模型。

summary_en.motivation: Companies need automated customer analytics tools that can handle dynamic, data-rich environments, yet academic research has largely ignored these managerial needs.
summary_en.method: We develop a Gaussian Process Propensity Model (GPPM) that places nonparametric priors over latent functions representing customer spending along calendar time, interpurchase time, and customer lifetime dimensions.
summary_en.result: The GPPM outperforms hazard and buy-till-you-die models in both fitting and forecasting real and simulated spending data.
summary_en.validation: The model is validated on two mobile game datasets and compared against state-of-the-art benchmark models.

papers.title: Predictive Entropy Search for Multi-objective Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract: We present PESMO, a Bayesian method for identifying the Pareto set of multi-objective optimization problems, when the functions are expensive to evaluate. The central idea of PESMO is to choose evaluation points so as to maximally reduce the entropy of the posterior distribution over the Pareto set. Critically, the PESMO multi-objective acquisition function can be decomposed as a sum of objective-specific acquisition functions, which enables the algorithm to be used in \emph{decoupled} scenarios in which the objectives can be evaluated separately and perhaps with different costs. This decoupling capability also makes it possible to identify difficult objectives that require more evaluations. PESMO also offers gains in efficiency, as its cost scales linearly with the number of objectives, in comparison to the exponential cost of other methods. We compare PESMO with other related methods for multi-objective Bayesian optimization on synthetic and real-world problems. The results show that PESMO produces better recommendations with a smaller number of evaluations of the objectives, and that a decoupled evaluation can lead to improvements in performance, particularly when the number of objectives is large.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该方法用于多目标贝叶斯优化，可减少昂贵函数评估次数，但未处理约束条件，且未直接应用于有限元或生物力学代理模型。
llm.why_not_core: Does not address constraints handling or uncertainty quantification for predictions, and lacks application to FEA or biomechanical design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效求解代价高昂的多目标优化问题的Pareto前沿
summary_zh.method: 基于熵搜索的采集函数，支持目标函数的解耦评估
summary_zh.result: 推荐集质量优于对比方法，且评估次数更少
summary_zh.validation: 在合成测试函数和实际问题上验证

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently identify the Pareto set of multi-objective optimization problems where function evaluations are expensive.
summary_en.method: Proposes PESMO, an acquisition function that maximizes the reduction in entropy of the posterior over the Pareto set, enabling decoupled evaluations.
summary_en.result: Outperforms existing multi-objective Bayesian optimization methods in terms of Pareto set quality with fewer objective evaluations.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic test functions and real-world problems, without application to FEA or biomechanics.

papers.title: Bayesian Optimization with Dimension Scheduling: Application to Biological Systems
papers.abstract: Bayesian Optimization (BO) is a data-efficient method for global black-box optimization of an expensive-to-evaluate fitness function. BO typically assumes that computation cost of BO is cheap, but experiments are time consuming or costly. In practice, this allows us to optimize ten or fewer critical parameters in up to 1,000 experiments. But experiments may be less expensive than BO methods assume: In some simulation models, we may be able to conduct multiple thousands of experiments in a few hours, and the computational burden of BO is no longer negligible compared to experimentation time. To address this challenge we introduce a new Dimension Scheduling Algorithm (DSA), which reduces the computational burden of BO for many experiments. The key idea is that DSA optimizes the fitness function only along a small set of dimensions at each iteration. This DSA strategy (1) reduces the necessary computation time, (2) finds good solutions faster than the traditional BO method, and (3) can be parallelized straightforwardly. We evaluate the DSA in the context of optimizing parameters of dynamic models of microalgae metabolism and show faster convergence than traditional BO.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文的贝叶斯优化方法可用于植入物或生物力学设计的参数优化，但未直接涉及有限元代理模型或约束处理。
llm.why_not_core: No explicit constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification beyond GP, and applied only to microalgae metabolism models, not implant or biomechanics FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 贝叶斯优化在大量实验时计算负担高，需降低计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 提出维度调度算法，每次迭代仅优化少量维度以加速收敛。
summary_zh.result: 在微藻动态模型参数优化中比传统贝叶斯优化收敛更快。
summary_zh.validation: 基于微藻代谢动态模型的仿真实验进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization becomes computationally expensive when many experiments are possible, requiring a method to reduce its computational burden.
summary_en.method: A Dimension Scheduling Algorithm is introduced that optimizes the fitness function along only a small subset of dimensions each iteration.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves faster convergence than standard Bayesian optimization on microalgae metabolism model parameter tuning.
summary_en.validation: Evaluation was performed via simulation of dynamic models of microalgae metabolism.
